headline.title: Patreon is laying off 20 percent of workers
headline.summary: Patreon is laying off approximately 93 employees, representing 20 percent of its workforce, as part of a restructuring effort. CEO Jack Conte emphasized that the layoffs are not due to AI replacing jobs, but rather a response to the transformative impact of AI on the tech industry.

articles.title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
articles.summary: AegisAI, a startup founded by former Google security executives, has raised $36 million to combat AI-driven spear phishing attacks. The company has developed AI agents capable of analyzing messages for subtle anomalies that traditional detection methods may overlook.

articles.title: Claude’s voice mode is now available for Opus and Sonnet
articles.summary: Anthropic has expanded its voice mode feature to include its Opus and Sonnet models, previously available only on the Claude Haiku model. This update allows integration with applications such as Gmail, Slack, and Canva, enhancing user accessibility to voice capabilities.

articles.title: AI chip startup Etched defies skeptics, hits $10.3B valuation from big-name investors
articles.summary: AI chip startup Etched, founded by three Harvard dropouts, has achieved a valuation of $10.3 billion after securing investments from prominent backers. The company claims its innovative chips and memory components can enhance inference speeds for any AI model without the need for GPUs.

articles.title: Meta’s New Feel-Good AI Ad Uses a Song About the World Ending
articles.summary: Meta has released a new advertisement featuring David Bowie's song "Five Years," which includes themes of existential crisis and environmental concerns. The ad aims to promote a positive message despite the song's somber lyrics about the world's end.

articles.title: Challenge: Hand coding weights for efficient sequence memorisation
articles.summary: Researchers have developed hand-coded weights for one-layer MLPs that effectively memorize labels for input token sequences of length two, achieving 90% accuracy. While the scaling of memorization capacity with parameter count is similar to that of trained models, the hand-coded models still lag behind in efficiency, suggesting potential for a hybrid approach that combines hand-coded input weights with learned output weights.

articles.title: Lawmakers prepare bill requiring AI ‘kill switch’
articles.summary: Lawmakers are set to introduce the "AI Kill Switch Act," which would mandate AI companies to disable or limit their systems upon request from the Department of Homeland Security. The bill is being spearheaded by Representatives Ted Lieu and Nathaniel Moran and is expected to be presented on Thursday.

articles.title: Google’s Gemini nears billion-user milestone
articles.summary: Google's Gemini has surpassed 750 million monthly users as of February and is approaching the milestone of one billion users. The rapid growth highlights the platform's increasing popularity and user engagement.

articles.title: Experts say exploiting Anthropic’s Fable isn’t how Kimi K3 got so good
articles.summary: Experts suggest that Kimi K3's rapid improvement cannot solely be attributed to exploiting Anthropic's Fable, as the model's strength likely stems from additional factors beyond just distillation. This insight was shared in a TechCrunch article discussing the advancements in AI model development.

articles.title: Apple’s OpenAI lawsuit is about who gets to define the post-smartphone era
articles.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that former employees took trade secrets related to AI technology when they joined the company. The case highlights the broader implications for the future of AI development and the competitive landscape in the post-smartphone era.

articles.title: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
articles.summary: Anthropic has updated its Claude voice mode with more advanced models that enhance functionality, allowing users to reschedule meetings and draft emails. This improvement aims to provide a more efficient and versatile user experience.

articles.title: The right-wing boomers protesting data centers have a lot in common with the left
articles.summary: A small group of protesters in central Florida gathered to oppose the construction of a hyperscale data center, despite a recent one-year moratorium on such developments approved by the Hernando County commission. The article explores the shared concerns between right-wing and left-wing groups regarding the impact of data centers on local communities.
